meta.description: One plan for every host: 5% of ticket sales, net of refunds, never more than ₹10,000 per 30-day billing cycle. Free events stay free, and your first 30 days from your first event are free.
meta.socialDescription: Free events stay free. Paid events: 5% of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 per billing cycle.

sections.title: Sell more, pay a smaller share.
sections.lead: The fee grows with your sales until it reaches ₹10,000 in a billing cycle, which happens at ₹2,00,000 of ticket sales. Everything you sell after that in the same 30-day cycle carries no {{brand.name}} fee.

sections.title: One plan, everything in it.
sections.lead: No tiers to compare and no features held back for a bigger plan.

sections.title: 30 days free. 90 if you’re early.
sections.lead: Your free days start at your first event, not when you sign up. Founding hosts get 90 days.

sections.title: Running several nights a week, or buying for a team?
sections.lead: Venues and companies pay the same 5%, with the same ₹10,000 cap per billing cycle. For venues with a weekly calendar, companies and shared spaces, and multi-day programmes, we’ll set {{brand.name}} up with you and talk through the right setup.

sections.title: The small print, in plain words.

items.question: When does the free trial start?
items.answer: At your first event, not when you sign up. For 30 days from then (90 for founding hosts), {{brand.name}} charges nothing on what you sell.

items.question: What counts toward the 5%?
items.answer: Ticket sales through {{brand.name}}, net of refunds. Free events count for nothing.

items.question: How does the ₹10,000 cap work?
items.answer: The fee stops growing once it reaches ₹10,000 in a 30-day billing cycle. That happens at ₹2,00,000 of ticket sales; anything you sell after that in the same cycle carries no {{brand.name}} fee. The cap starts again with each cycle.

items.question: Do venues and companies pay more?
items.answer: No. Venues and companies pay the same 5%, with the same ₹10,000 cap per billing cycle.

items.question: Who pays payment gateway fees?
items.answer: They’re separate from the {{brand.name}} fee. Your payment provider charges them at its own rate.

items.question: How are weddings priced?
items.answer: Weddings and multi-day programmes are priced per wedding, by headcount, as a guided pilot.
